label: PF Backlog 238
title: Verbose-gated logging + loops/tool-calls in the summary report
body: Make all diagnostic logging parameter-based (PIPELINE_VERBOSE/logLevel): [LLM], [HEARTBEAT], [Estimate], per-call payloads. Enabled now; minimal later. Add 'LLM loops (calls) per agent' and tool-call counts to the agent-end summary and final report (ledger already has the data).
_note: Slice: PIPELINE_VERBOSE gate + env_flags.verbose(); per-call [LLM] log gated. Tool-call/loop counts surfaced in the agent summary already. Remaining: extend gating to heartbeats + optional prompt/response capture.
